description: Deployment config for the environment classifier (fine-tuned SegFormer-B0). Consumed by environment_model/env_model.py. Thresholds were tuned on the own-frames validation split only (dataset/eval/own_split.csv, tune_thresholds.py, fine log-grid 2026-07-12); test rides never touched by tuning.
model: SegFormer-B0, base nvidia/segformer-b0-finetuned-ade-512-512, fine-tuned on Mapillary Vistas + ADE20K water (3 env classes + other)

test_metrics_own_frames.note: 1210 held-out cyclist-POV frames (32+ rides, incl. 8 water rides), 2026-07-12
